patterns.name: Flow Did Not Complete
patterns.description: A flow started but critical signals were never emitted

resolution.description: Flow started but never completed - check for early returns, unhandled branches, or silent failures
resolution.codeHint: Ensure all code paths emit completion signals, add error boundaries that emit failure signals

patterns.name: Gate Bypassed
patterns.description: A gate check was skipped or circumvented

resolution.description: Security gate was bypassed - audit code paths to ensure all routes check gates
resolution.codeHint: Add gate middleware to all relevant routes, audit direct function calls that skip gate checks

patterns.name: State Race Condition
patterns.description: Component accessed state that was not yet loaded

resolution.description: Component accessed data before it was loaded - add loading guards
resolution.codeHint: Check loading state before rendering, add loading skeletons, use suspense boundaries

patterns.name: Unhandled Signal
patterns.description: A signal was emitted but no handler responded

resolution.description: Signal was emitted but not handled - add signal handler or check signal routing
resolution.codeHint: Add handler for the signal, or check if signal name is correct

patterns.name: Gate Cascade Failure
patterns.description: Multiple gates failed in sequence, indicating deeper issue

resolution.description: Multiple gates failing suggests a root cause issue - check shared dependencies
resolution.codeHint: Identify common dependency between failing gates, check service health, review recent deployments

patterns.name: Integration Configuration Missing
patterns.description: Integration failed due to missing configuration

resolution.description: Integration configuration is missing - check environment variables and config files
resolution.codeHint: Verify .env file, check deployment secrets, ensure config is loaded before integration init

patterns.name: Operation on Unmounted Component
patterns.description: Async operation completed after component unmounted

resolution.description: Async operation running on unmounted component - add cleanup or cancellation
resolution.codeHint: Use AbortController, add cleanup in useEffect, check mounted state before setState

patterns.name: Feature Flag Not Found
patterns.description: Feature flag check failed because flag doesn't exist

resolution.description: Feature flag doesn't exist or isn't configured - add flag definition
resolution.codeHint: Add feature flag to configuration, provide default value for missing flags

patterns.name: Invalid State Transition
patterns.description: Attempted to transition to invalid state from current state

resolution.description: State machine received invalid transition - check state machine definition and trigger
resolution.codeHint: Review state machine transitions, add guards for invalid transitions, log current state before transition

patterns.name: Purpose File Not Defined
patterns.description: Symbol referenced but has no .purpose file

resolution.description: Symbol is used but not documented - add .purpose file for the symbol
resolution.codeHint: Create .purpose file in the symbol's directory describing its intent
